WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, f.channel_code, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
), sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(s.net_amount) gross_sales, sum(CASE WHEN s.staff_purchase_flag THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_sales
  FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND s.channel_code = 'ST'
  GROUP BY 1
), rets AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) refunds, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) nd
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.sqm, round(sales.gross_sales,0) sales_before_returns, round(coalesce(rets.refunds,0),0) refunds, round(sales.gross_sales - coalesce(rets.refunds,0),0) net_sales, round(staff_sales,0) staff, rets.n, rets.nd
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name, sqm FROM dim_store) st JOIN sales USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN rets USING (store_id)
ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 20

WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
), sl AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, s.sale_date AS d, s.net_amount AS amt FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key WHERE s.channel_code='ST' AND st.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT st.store_id, r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key WHERE st.store_id < 900
), agg AS (
  SELECT store_id,
   sum(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-29' AND DATE '2025-04-27' THEN amt END) fy2425,
   sum(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN amt END) fy2526,
   sum(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN amt END) t12m,
   count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND amt>0 THEN d END) trading_days_2526
  FROM sl GROUP BY 1
), rpt AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt2526 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.store_id, round(fy2425,0) fy2425, round(fy2526,0) fy2526, round(t12m,0) t12m, trading_days_2526, round(rpt2526,0) rpt2526
FROM agg a LEFT JOIN rpt USING (store_id) ORDER BY fy2526 DESC LIMIT 14

SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m, channel_code, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sale_date) n_days, count(DISTINCT store_key) n_stores, round(sum(net_amount),0) net
FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
), movements AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, l.net_amount AS amount
  FROM lines l JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = l.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND l.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT st.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
), totals AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(amount) AS net_sales FROM movements GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY t.net_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, t.store_id,
  (SELECT max(store_name) FROM dim_store d WHERE d.store_id = t.store_id) AS store_name,
  round(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM totals t ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 12
